entries.text: Deborah: Hey Jolene! Great news - I just started a project for a cleanup in our community and have been trying to raise funds for it. It's been amazing to see everyone come together to make a difference. How've you been? Anything new going on?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Hey Debs! Congrats on your project for the community! As for me, life's been a rollercoaster lately. Last week, I had a huge setback with my project. I put in so much work and it all crashed and I lost everything. SO frustrating and depressing.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Jolene, sorry to hear that. It must be really tough. I'm here for you and if I can do anything, just let me know. Is there anything that's helping you cope?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Your support means a lot. Susie really helps when times get tough. Pets have been great company. Video games have also been a nice distraction. [shares image: a photo of a man holding a snake on his arm]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: They can really provide love and comfort, especially during tough times. How did you come to have Susie?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: I adopted her two years ago when I was feeling lonely and wanted some company.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: That's great, Jolene! Animals sure have a way of bringing us happiness. They understand us and provide us with comfort. Plus, having a pet teaches us responsibility. She came at the perfect time - cherish those moments with her and find strength in her presence.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Thanks Deborah. Having her around shows me I can stay strong and find joy in the small stuff.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Enjoying the little things is key. Those little moments can give us a boost and push us forward. How have you been taking care of yourself lately?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: I'm trying to prioritize self-care, like yoga and meditation. It helps me stay balanced and grounded.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah:  If you're interested, I can suggest some routines for you to try.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene:  I'm always on the lookout for new routines to mix things up.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: In the meantime, check out this great place for yoga. [shares image: a photo of a room with a lot of yoga mats on the floor]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: This room looks perfect for it. Do you have any favorite routines you can share?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: One of my favorite yoga routines is a gentle flow that's all about breathing and grounding. It helps me find my chill. I'll send you a tutorial video with the poses. This is me in the process :) [shares image: a photo of a woman in a pink shirt doing a yoga pose]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Wow! Does that help you find your chill or improve your concentration?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: It's a great way to find balance in tough times. Try it out and let me know what you think!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Can't wait to try it out. Let's chat soon!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Let me know how it goes. Talk to you later!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Yep, I'll practice and update you. Bye!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Since we last spoke, I made a meditation guide for my yoga retreat. How about you?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: I have been stressed since I lost my work files. I was so overwhelmed...but meditation kept me chill and I got my clarity back, thank goodness. Really appreciate the practice!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: It's amazing how it can give you peace and calm in times like that. If you ever need any support, just let me know - we're in this together!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene:  Appreciate your support! BTW, I wanted to share this with you. [shares image: a photo of two notebooks with a blue cover and a white strip]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Your creativity is amazing!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Thanks, Deb! I was inspired by my love for space and engines, so I designed these notebooks with elements like galaxies and circuitry. I think they turned out really cool!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: You have such a knack for turning these into art. They make me feel excited just by looking at them. Your creativity is amazing! Does that usually inspire your engineering projects too?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Seeing art and design in various things gives me a unique perspective on problems.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Got any neat projects or ideas you're pumped about?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene:  Working on a cool project now - a prototype that could revolutionize aerial surveillance. Can't wait to see the results!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: I admire your ambition to make a difference. Do you have any specific plans or goals for this project?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: My aim is to devise a more productive and affordable aerial surveillance system. It'll help with responding to emergencies and monitoring the environment. It'll make the world a better, safer place.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: I love your commitment. Keep going!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Thanks, Deb! Your support means a lot. I'll keep pushing and doing my best to make a difference.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: You got this!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Been thinking a lot about my plans lately, especially after checking in with my bf. It's been up and down!  Some days it feels like I'm trying to juggle my engineering, relationship, and growing as a person, and I just don't know how to handle it all. How do you manage when it's too much? [shares image: a photo of a book with a checklist on it]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Finding ways to restore balance is important. Taking time for yourself and recognizing your needs can make a difference.  [shares image: a photo of a room with a moss wall and a floor cushion]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Thanks, Deb! I've been trying out some time management strategies recently and started using a bullet journal. It's been really helpful for tracking my tasks and staying organized.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah:  It's great to hear that it's been helping you out!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene:  Not only does it help me stay on top of everything, but it's also so satisfying when I cross tasks off my list. Here's a pic of my newest spread with one of my favorite quotes. [shares image: a photo of a notebook with a quote on it]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: I love this quote. So uplifting. Does it motivate you when you see it?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Yeah, it's like a little reminder to stick to my goals and never give up.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Gotcha! Visual reminders like this photo can be super motivating. Keep focusing on your goals, Jolene, and don't give up! I led a meditation yoga sessionto the elderly at a local care home last week during sunset. Nature can be really helpful for finding peace. Have you tried mindfulness too?  [shares image: a photo of a group of people doing yoga on a beach]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Haven't tried it yet, but I'm keen to give it a shot. That sounds really peaceful. I could use some of that calm in my life right now.  I'm interested in destressing and trying mindfulness.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: I started with workshops and books, and now mindfulness is a huge part of my life.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene:  I'll definitely look into some of it. Can't wait to get started!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: That's great, Jolene! I'm so glad you're willing to try some mindfulness. It can be really helpful. Let me know if you need any help getting started - I'm happy to assist you with your journey!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene:  I really appreciate it.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: We're in this together. Give me a shout if you need anything. Bye for now.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Thanks, I'll hit you up if I need anything. Bye for now.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Hey Jolene! Hope you're having a good one. Last Friday I told Anna the story of my life and they were super kind about it. It was so nice to have a meaningful connection. How's the mindfulness workshops and reading going? Need any help?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Life's been hella busy since we last talked. I bought a console for my partner as a gift on the 17th and it's so much fun, he even managed to play it.! Engineering studies are still going strong too. Balance has been key for me lately. How about you? What's been up? [shares image: a photo of a black xbox console with a yoda yoda figure next to it]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah:  Well done! As for me, I've been focusing on teaching yoga and spending time with the community. Organizing a yoga event last month was really cool.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene:  Was it rewarding seeing everyone come together? Can you tell me more about how you put it together? Also, any tips for maintaining a balance between hobbies and studies?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah:  I reached out to different nearby businesses and places to make it happen. We had yoga, food stalls, and even some live music - it was amazing! As for balancing hobbies and studies, I find it helpful to prioritize and manage my time effectively. Making a schedule and setting aside specific time for studying and pursuing hobbies can go a long way in maintaining balance.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Wow, that's awesome! Gonna make a plan to manage my studies and hobbies. Say, do you ever play video games?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: I used to play some video games, but it's been a while. It's a good way to relax after a busy day. Do you have any game suggestions? What's your favorite game?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: I have a few game recommendations. Zelda BOTW for Switch is an awesome open-world game. Animal Crossing: New Horizons is really calming and cute. As for my favorite game, it's hard to choose just one!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text:
Deborah: Cool recs! I'll definitely check those out. What about your favorite memories of playing video games?
 [shares image: a photo of a man and a woman sitting in a chair in front of a computer]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Oh, I forgot to mention Overcooked 2 - this is a good co-op game if you're into hilarious and chaotic cooking. My partner and I often play for bets! I once won three large pizzas!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Reminds me of when I used to play games with my husband. We'd take turns and it was a great way to bond and make memories. Gaming really can bring people closer, right?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Yeah, you`re right! What's your favorite game to play with that person?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: We prefer to play detective games together.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: What other activities do you both enjoy doing together?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: We also enjoyed spending time outdoors and exploring nature. It was always so refreshing to be outside and soak up the fresh air.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: I'm a big fan of being outside too! It's so calming and refreshing. Do you have any special spots you like to go to?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: I love going to this park near my house - it has a nice forest trail and a beach. It's a peaceful spot where I can do some yoga and reflect. There's also a special bench that holds special meaning to me.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Sounds lovely! Nature can be calming. What makes this bench special to you? [shares image: a photo of a bench in a park with a tree in the background]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: It holds a lot of special memories for me and my mom - we would come here and chat about dreams and life. It's full of good moments.  [shares image: a photo of a person sitting on a bench in a forest]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: That's awesome, Deborah! What were some of your favorite memories with your mom at this spot? It looks super peaceful and pretty.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: I'll always cherish my memories with her at this spot. I remember a beautiful sunset we watched together in silence - the colors in the sky were so special. Every time I go back, I feel so much peace and gratitude for the time I spent with her.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Places and moments like that can mean so much, and it's a gift to find peace and gratitude in them.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah:  I'm really thankful for all the time we had.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: It's so important to cherish it.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene:  Long time no talk! We were given a new game for the console last week, it is Battlefield 1. What's been up with you?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Hey Jolene! Good to hear from you. That`s cool! Been thinking about a few big moments lately - went to a place that held a lot of memories for me. Sat on a bench where we used to chat and it brought back a lot of emotions.  [shares image: a photo of a flower cart on a sidewalk with flowers in it]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Mostly happy or a bit of everything?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: It was quite a mix, Jolene. I felt nostalgia and longing, but also grateful for the memories. It's amazing how a place can mean so much. I brought these flowers there. [shares image: a photo of a vase of flowers on the ground in a street]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Do you think she would like it?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text:
Deborah: Yeah, my mom really loved flowers. They always made her so happy. She appreciated the simple things in life.
 [shares image: a photo of a woman holding a bouquet of red roses]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Wow, that's a great photo! How did she show you to appreciate it?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: By taking it slow, seeing beauty in them, and finding joy.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Wow Deb, that's awesome! We should definitely take time to enjoy that and not let the business of life cause us to miss out on the good stuff.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Yeah, Jolene. Life can be so busy that we often overlook the small things that truly matter. Let's make an effort to appreciate them more.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Yep Deb, slowing down and enjoying simple moments can bring a lot of balance and happiness. I'm trying to do more yoga and meditation myself to help relax and stay focused. Are there any calming habits that you practice to feel balanced?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Yeah, same here, Jolene! Yoga and meditation help me find balance and inner peace. Going out for walks and staying mindful also keep me grounded. I take similar photos on walks. [shares image: a photo of a sunset over a body of water]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Gorgeous! Going for a walk and feeling so peaceful must be amazing.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Moments like that I'll always cherish.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: That calm and peaceful feeling is so nice - it's great for recharging and thinking.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah:  It's like a reboot for me.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Got it! It's like hitting the refresh button and coming back even better. [shares image: a photo of a green cushion on a floor in front of a window]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: What's your favorite yoga pose for some rest?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: I'm a fan of savasana - aka the corpse pose. It's so calming and helps me just let go and surrender. [shares image: a photo of a person laying on the floor with a paper bag]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Funny photo! How long have you been doing yoga?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Been doing it for 3 years. It's a great way to escape studying and work stress.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Wow, Jolene! Taking time to unwind is key and that seems just right for you!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: I'm really finding my zen again!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Keep it up!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Thanks for your support, Deb!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Good luck with everything. Stay in touch.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Hey Jolene! Good to hear from you! A lot's happened since we talked - last week I got to go to this yoga retreat near my mom's place. It was so cool - I got to hang with nature and really get to know myself. Definitely life-changing! That's how beautiful it was there! [shares image: a photo of a trail in a forest with moss and trees]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Wow, Deb, sounds great! Glad you got to connect with yourself and nature. That's my own way to relax. What are your thoughts on life now? [shares image: a photo of a man bending over on a blanket in the grass]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text:
Deborah: Life's been super meaningful lately. Nature and self-reflection have helped me see how beautiful every moment is. We can really grow and learn when we listen to ourselves. What's been up with you lately? Any insights or experiences?
 [shares image: a photo of a mountain range with a colorful sunset in the background]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Life's been hectic, but I'm making strides toward my goals. It's tough, but satisfying.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Can you tell me a bit more about it and what you've achieved?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: My goal is to be successful in my field and make a positive impact. I've been studying, attending workshops, and networking to make it happen. Recently, I had the opportunity to present at a virtual conference and received positive feedback.  It was a great experience and confirmed that I'm on the right track.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: You really put your heart and soul into it. Must have been amazing having it go so well. How did it feel when people gave you positive feedback? Any ideas for what comes next?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: I was thrilled to receive such positive feedback! It felt so rewarding to know that my efforts were appreciated. Right now, I'm focusing on studying and gaining more experience. I'm even thinking about more internships to further enhance my skills. Exciting times! Hopefully, there will be more updates to share with you soon.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Wow, Jolene! Way to go! I'm super proud of all you've achieved. Let me know if you need any help. Onward!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Thanks, Deb! Your support means a lot to me.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: No problem. You got this!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene:  I'm not giving up, just gonna keep pushing forward.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Reach for your goals and don't forget to enjoy the journey.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Thanks, Deb. Your support means a lot. I'll keep pushing forward and remember to enjoy every step of the way.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Come on! The journey's as important as the destination. Take time for yourself and find joy in it. We believe in you! [shares image: a photo of a field of sunflowers with a sunset in the background]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Yeah, you're right! I'll take your advice and find joy on the way. Cheers for the support! [shares image: a photo of a city skyline at sunset with a body of water]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Always by your side!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Hey Jolene, since we talked I've been thinking about my mom's influence. Remembering those we love is important.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: I understand, Deb. Remembering and cherishing the memories of our loved ones is so important. It's comforting to know that their influence still guides us. Last Friday, my partner and I talked about how our loved ones have influenced us and what their values meant to us. It was an emotional chat, but it made us feel closer and showed us what really matters.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Those types of conversations really help build relationships. Can you tell me more about the values they have given you?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Definitely! Our loved ones have taught us to persevere and stay resilient, like my mom always said to never give up, and my partner's dad showed them to stay determined. Their values have influenced us to pursue our goals, such as me with engineering and my partner with their creative endeavors. Even though they're not here, we both feel their values encouraging us along our paths.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: That's wonderful to hear, Jolene! It's amazing how their values continue to guide you, even in their absence. It sounds like you and your partner are honoring their memory by pursuing your respective passions. Have you ever considered incorporating those values into your work as well?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Yeah, Deborah! We've been figuring out how to add these values into our projects. As an engineering student, I want to use my talents to do good and help solve important problems. I'm keen on coming up with new ideas and making things more efficient to make the world a better place. Going further, my mom stressed the value of helping others and that's something I want to keep in mind for my engineering projects.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: When our work ties into our values, it becomes more meaningful. What goals or ideas do you have for incorporating those values into your future projects?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: In the future, I'm aiming to work on projects that make a real difference to communities. I'm interested in sustainable initiatives and developing innovative solutions for environmental issues. I also want to get involved with organizations that focus on social causes, using my skills to help out. It's about connecting my passion for engineering with my commitment to making a positive impact.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: You've got a lot of amazing plans for the future. Which projects are you most interested in getting involved in?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: I'm keen on two projects in particular. One is focused on developing renewable energy, like solar, to help communities and reduce dependence on non-renewables.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Wow Jolene, that's really inspiring!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: The other is finding ways to supply clean water to those with limited access. Both align with my beliefs about sustainability and assisting those in need. I still have so much to figure out before beginning, but I'm up for the challenge.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Sounds great, Jolene! Research is key to success. Little steps and being up for challenges make you stronger. I'm here for you. Connecting to yourself helps tackle any issue. Here's a photo that reminds me of the beauty of nature during a yoga session. [shares image: a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on the beach]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: It helps with challenges, giving balance and strength. Any tips for staying relaxed while studying?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Taking breaks, doing some stretching/yoga, or just going for a walk is really helpful. And don't forget to get enough sleep and take time for self-care. Finding a balance between work and taking care of yourself is important. What self-care activities have you been doing lately?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: I've been into yoga and meditation lately. It helps me recharge. Doing different poses relieves tension and calms my mind. I've already shared my newfound love for yoga with my partner, and we're planning to go on a meditation retreat together to enhance our practice together. [shares image: a photo of a woman in a pink shirt doing a yoga pose]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Glad to hear that yoga is helping you rest and recharge. It's great for reflection and self-care. Do your snakes also enjoy it?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: My snakes just like watching me chill. But she's a great company and always brings a sense of calm.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Having a pet around is such a calming feeling. They sure can bring a great sense of comfort. I still have cats, Luna is sitting on the left. [shares image: a photo of two cats sitting on a window sill looking out]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Aww, that's adorable! What's the second one's name?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Max! They bring lots of joy and peace to our home. [shares image: a photo of a brown leather chair and a black and white floor]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: How did you get them?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Max is my mother's cat, I took him when my mother passed away. [shares image: a photo of a car with a fan and a mesh bag]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: You're great for taming him. How did you get Luna?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: I took Luna from the shelter.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: It’s wonderful that you have become their loving owner!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Yes, I really love cats, and they also need a home, love, and care! Moreover, Max is already old, he is 8 years old.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: How old is Luna?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: She is younger, she is 5 years old.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: I am proud of your action to tame these pets!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Hey Deborah, how's it going? Guess what? Yesterday my partner and I got back from an awesome trip to Rio de Janeiro- we checked out some cool yoga classes. [shares image: a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose in a mirror]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: That yoga pose looks great. Must've been a cool experience for the two of you. What did the trip teach you?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: This country was awesome! It showed me different kinds of yoga and their backgrounds, which made me appreciate it even more. We visited a lot of delicious cafes! Have you ever been somewhere that was important to you?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Yep, last month I visited my mom`s house which holds a special place in my heart. My mom had good and bad times there, but it's still a symbol of her strength and the love she shared with me. This is my husband in front of this house. [shares image: a photo of a man standing in front of a house]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: What was it like?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: It brought back fond memories as I relaxed outside.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Sounds great! So glad you have a place to relax and find peace.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Thanks, Jolene. It's special for me. How about you? Is there a place that helps you relax?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: I go to this nearby place to meditate by a tranquil spot. [shares image: a photo of a pond with lily pads and a tree in the background]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Looks chill. What's been the effect of that?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: It helps me make sense of everything and relieves stress. It's like a restart.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text:
Deborah: Cool, glad you found a place to chill. We all need that occasionally. This is one of my favorite spots to ponder and let things go.
 [shares image: a photo of a lake with a few trees in the water]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Looks great! What made you pick that spot?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: The soothing vibes and nice views made it ideal for reflecting and letting go.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Here is one more photo from Rio de Janeiro. We went on many excursions there. [shares image: a photo of a group of people walking up a set of stairs]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Wow, those stairs look cool! Where were they taken?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: We had a great time visiting an old temple. The stairs were amazing!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Wow, exploring those temples must have been incredible! Three years ago I was also in Rio de Janeiro, I took a beautiful photo on one of the excursions. [shares image: a photo of a large stone structure with a mountain in the background]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: The architecture and history of it all were really interesting. I'm sure you also liked the places you visited there!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Exploring historical places and learning their stories is so fun. It was a great experience. I want to share this photo with you. [shares image: a photo of a hand holding a piece of paper with writing on it]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene:  By the way, what did that paper have written on it in the photo?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: This was written to me by a friend who, unfortunately, will never be able to support me. I miss him here. This quote says"Let go of what no longer serves you."

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: I'm sorry! That's a good reminder to stay focused and let go of what no longer serves us. Remember the quote in my notebook? It also inspires me! [shares image: a photo of a notebook with a quote on it]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: What other quotes give you strength?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: I came across this one while browsing and it really hit home with me. It's a great reminder to ditch the negative stuff and focus on growing and being positive. [shares image: a photo of a notebook with a pen and a plant on a table]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Surrounding ourselves with good stuff and striving to improve is key.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Yep, Deborah! It's about creating a good atmosphere to help us grow and improve. By the way, I have a new plant. [shares image: a photo of a plant in a pot on a patio]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: What made you pick it?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: I got this as a reminder to nurture myself and embrace fresh starts.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Nice job, Jolene! Take care of yourself and embrace new beginnings.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Thanks Deb! Will do. Good talking to you. Take care!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Have a great day!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Hey Jolene, just catching up. I went to a cool event last week with the aim to support each other - pretty inspiring. Have you been connecting with anyone lately?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Hey Deb, great to hear from you! I've been focusing on studying and my relationship with my partner. We're taking little trips to the beach, it's a great way to relax. How about you, anything new going on?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: I was busy too - went to a community meetup last Friday. We shared stories and it was nice to feel how connected we are. It made me think about how important relationships are. How about you, how are things going in that area?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: I'm really thankful for my significant other right now. It's great to have someone encouraging my goals! How are things with your friends and family? Any updates on that front?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Relationships with family and friends are so vital. My yoga pals have been my second family - we've held each other up through a lot. The other day I found this old photo. That was when I first started doing yoga. My mum was my biggest fan and source of motivation. She'd often come to my classes with me. [shares image: a photo of a woman sitting on a yoga mat with two children]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Our loved ones sure are supportive! When I was 10, my parents got me that and it was the start of my passion for video games. [shares image: a photo of a nintendo game console and a game controller]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Cool that they shared that with you. Did you learn on your own or did they teach you?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: I taught myself, but my dad was always supportive and my mom would play games with me.  [shares image: a photo of a nintendo wii game system with a game on the screen]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: That's awesome! Sounds like you had a lot of support from your parents. What was your favorite game to play with mom?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: One of my favorites was "Monster Hunter: World". The immersive story and open-world gaming are amazing!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah:  It can be so freeing when you get immersed in a game like that.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Yeah! It's my way to de-stress and take a break from life.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: What's up this month? Anything fun happening for you?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Got a lot of finals coming up this month, so I've been studying real hard. It's been quite stressful, but it'll be worth it in the end. Thinking about taking a trip somewhere to relax and recharge afterward.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Good luck with it! Let me know if there's anything I can do to assist you.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Woohoo! I signed up for a meditation course at a retreat near a lake. Can't wait to share this experience with my partner and learn some new techniques. Sooo excited! [shares image: a photo of a building with a curved roof on a hill]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: That`s awesome! It looks so calm in the pic - I hope you enjoy your experience and learn some new techniques!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene:  It's amazing how something so easy can make such a big difference to our health!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Yep, it's become part of my routine now. Can't imagine my life without it.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Yeah, same! It helps me stay balanced during my studies.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Glad to hear it, Jolene. How's the project going?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene:  It's tough but I'm chugging along. Thanks!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: You're so strong for handling all the challenges. You've got this!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Thanks, Deb! Your support really means a lot. I'll keep pushing forward.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: No worries, Jolene. I'm here if you need me. Take care of yourself and don't forget to rest up.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: What have you been doing lately?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: I recently saw this wonderful sunrise again. [shares image: a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Glimpsing that calms me. Taking beach walks relaxes me.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Did my photo remind you of something?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: That shot was like a reminder of my last beach getaway. So chill and nice.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Glad it brought back good memories.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Maybe one day we will be able to watch the sunrise together!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: An offer I can't refuse!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Bye, Deb! See you later!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: See ya! Stay safe and catch you later. Bye!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Hey Jolene, had a tough week. Storm forced us to cancel our yoga getaway.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Sorry to hear about it. How are you feeling now?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: I was bummed about it, but I'm doing better now. It was just a setback, but I found comfort in my work and spending time at home. Reminds me to be grateful for the little things. And you? How's it going?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: My partner and I plan a camping trip to connect with nature and practice yoga.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: It can be both good and tough to plan activities with a busy schedule - what strategies do you use?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Having a routine helps me stay on top of everything I need to do. I have a schedule for classes, studying, and personal time. Self-care activities like yoga and meditation help me stay balanced and relax.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: I'd love to learn more about how you do it.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene:  I can tell you about it if you're interested. It took a bit of experimenting, but it's really helped me.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Sounds great! Let's set up a coffee date and talk about it!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Wanna meet up at that cafe next Monday? Let's try fresh pastries. [shares image: a photo of a coffee shop with a bunch of coffee machines]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Sounds good, Jolene! When did you have in mind? That cafe rocks.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: How about Wednesday at 4? Can't wait to catch up over coffee! [shares image: a photo of a person holding a cup of coffee in front of a bunch of flowers]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: That pic looks so peaceful. Reminded me of a cool hidden coffee shop near me. Rate it! [shares image: a photo of a group of people sitting at tables in a room]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Tell me more about it when we meet, maybe next time we’ll be there.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Sorry, I remembered that I already have plans for this day.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Now I'll see when it's more convenient for me.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Thank you for your understanding, I'm waiting.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: How about Friday at 5? I will need to sort out the books from this bookcase and I will be free. [shares image: a photo of a room with a book shelf and a ceiling fan]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Absolutely, let's do that! Can't wait for our coffee date next week. See you then. Stay safe!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: See ya soon, Deb! Be safe and I'm excited for our coffee date!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Maybe just grab me some interesting books!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Hey Deb! So sorry for the late reply, been super busy. Last weekend my partner and I traveled to a meditation retreat for a few weeks in Phuket. Amazing experience! Nature, reflection and a break from engineering studies were awesome - it helped me find inner peace. [shares image: a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on the beach]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah:  I'd love to hear more about your reflections there and how they changed you.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: At the retreat, I had time to reflect on what makes me happy. It made me realize the importance of incorporating relaxation, self-care, and balance in life alongside my engineering studies. The beauty of nature there was so inspiring and refreshing!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah:  Was there anything from the retreat that stood out to you?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: The one session that really stood out was about releasing expectations and judgments and just savoring the present. It was a strong reminder to not just dwell on the finish line, but to appreciate the journey too. I usually get too consumed with hitting my goals that I forget to appreciate the ride.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah:  I've been thinking about this a lot, too. Life's full of small moments and being grateful for those can really boost our happiness.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Yup, totally agree! Sometimes we get too focused on the big stuff and don't appreciate all the tiny wins. Like the feeling of the sun or a great cup of coffee - can be small but they make life much better. Trying to be more mindful and grateful to take it all in now.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: That's great, Jolene! Practicing mindfulness and gratitude can really change our day-to-day. Even just a different outlook can make the little things in life joyful. Glad you're getting into it!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: I'm experiencing a new level of joy and happiness!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah:  It's wonderful to see your progress, and I'm excited to be on this journey with you!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Thanks, Deb! Appreciate your support. It's great that we can do this together.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Having a supportive community definitely helps. We can motivate and encourage each other! By the way, I recently played a game. I don't remember what it's called. This is a card game about cats, where you take cards one by one from a deck, and then you can attack your opponent with them. We'll definitely play it with you! [shares image: a photo of two children standing on yoga mats in a room]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: I look forward to meeting you and playing this game!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Since speaking last, I reconnected with my mom's old friends. Their stories made me tear up and reminded me how lucky I am to have had her. [shares image: a photo of a living room with a couch and a fire place]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene:  It's great that you could reconnect with them. Hearing stories about our loved ones can be tough but also comforting.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Hearing stories about my mom was emotional. It was both happy and sad to hear things I hadn't heard before. It was a mix of emotions, but overall it was comforting to reconnect with her friends.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: It can bring up a range of emotions, and it's okay to feel a mix of happiness and sadness. Those moments with her friends must've been meaningful to you.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Wow, it was so special. A glimpse into her life beyond what I knew. Through their eyes, I appreciate her more. Here I am and my mom. [shares image: a photo of two women in pajamas taking a selfie in a mirror]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: That looks like a blast! What did you and your mom's friends do on that day?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: We reminisced and looked through her photos. It was really sweet.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Looking at old photos must have been so nostalgic! It's great that you could share that experience with friends. It's amazing how photos and memories can give us a deeper appreciation for the people we love.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Pictures really have a way of bringing back memories and making us appreciate the special bond we have with our loved ones. They remind me of how strong love is and how amazing human relationships can be. Just like this one. [shares image: a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Wow, what a gorgeous pic! Do you have any special memories of that beach or just love surfing in general?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: That beach is super special to me. It's where I got married and discovered my love for surfing. It's always filled with joy and peace.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: What pleasant memories.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Here is another photo from my classes. [shares image: a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on the beach]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Wow, that yoga pose looks amazing! Does it help you relax?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Oh yeah! Doing this on the beach is so peaceful - the ocean, sand, and fresh air create a super relaxing atmosphere. The perfect way to take care of myself.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene:  I like to create my own serene yoga space with candles and oils for extra chill vibes. Also, we tried a new style of meditation in Thailand - with flowers. [shares image: a photography of a couple of towels sitting on top of a table]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Oh, same for me!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: I find calm when I do yoga or meditate. I use essential oils and put on some soft, soothing music in the background to create a peaceful atmosphere. It really helps me chill out and center myself.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah:  It's amazing how our environment can enhance our practice.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Yeah, totally! Our surroundings can really affect our mood and how much zen we can get from our routine. Creating a place that feels safe and chill is key. [shares image: a photo of a bed with a colorful blanket and pillows]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Wow, that looks so comfy and inviting! Where do you usually go to relax in your house?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: In my room, I usually go to relax and feel at ease. After a busy day, it's my little haven for peace and rest - the perfect spot to relax and recharge.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Sounds like your room does the job. That's awesome.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene:  Here are my pals keeping me company. [shares image: a photo of a person holding a snake in a container]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Hey, that's Susie or Seraphim? How long has he been hanging out with you?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: It`s Susie! I've had her for two years now.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: It's awesome how pets can bring us comfort and peace when we need it.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Susie is a great companion.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: The love pets give is priceless.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Plus, they make life a lot brighter!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Hey Jolene, I'm so excited to tell you! Yesterday, me and my neighbor ran a free gardening class for the community, it was awesome! People of any age joined in and it was such a great thing to see.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Wow, Deborah, that's awesome! Keep up the great work, and here's hoping for more events like this in the future!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah:  Gardening is really amazing. It brings us together in such a cool way. It was awesome to share my love of plants and help people take care of the world. So, what about you? Anything new happened lately?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: We tried a scuba diving lesson last Friday and had an awesome time! We found a cool dive spot we can explore together. Trying new things opens up a world of adventure - maybe one day I'll be a certified diver. Anything fun going on with you?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: That sounds amazing, Jolene! I've been interested in underwater life, but I haven't had the chance to try scuba diving yet. Recently, I've been spending time remembering my mom. Last Sunday, I visited her old house and sat on a bench. It was a comforting experience, as if I could feel her presence guide me and remind me of her love.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Visiting your mom's old home sounds like it was really special. Is there something special you remember about her?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Thanks, Jolene! It was really special. My mom had a big passion for cooking. She would make amazing meals for us, each one full of love and warmth. I can still remember the smell of her special dish, it would fill the house and bring us all together. [shares image: a photo of a bowl of food with a spoon in it]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Mmm, that looks delicious, Deb! So sweet how cooking with your mom brought everyone together. What's your best memory of cooking with her?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: I loved it when she would bake pineapple birthday cakes for me when I was a kid. It always made me feel so special. [shares image: a photo of a pineapple cake with a smiley face on it]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: No wonder it made you feel special.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Have you ever had something like that with someone close? [shares image: a photo of a mixer with a whisk in it]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: I used to bake cookies with someone close to me. [shares image: a photo of four chocolate chip cookies on a baking sheet]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: What's your favorite cookie to make?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: The warm, gooey chocolate and soft, buttery cookie are a match made in heaven.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: I really want to eat this now.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Well look what I have here! [shares image: a photo of a person holding a book open on a bed]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah:  Is there anything special about it or the photo?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: It takes me to another world when I read it!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Did I show you that I have a big bookshelf too? [shares image: a photo of a living room with a couch and a book shelf]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: I think not, I really like it!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Having a space like this is important for escaping reality and relaxing with a book. Do you have any books that really moved you? [shares image: a photo of a bathroom with a black and white wall and a wooden stool]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: My bathroom has an aesthetic vibe. Once I read a self-discovery book there and it really resonated with me.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Wow! A special book that speaks to you and helps with self-discovery? That's awesome. Plus, having a cozy nook to chill? That's my best one! [shares image: a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Sounds nice, Deb! A cozy nook is a must! The beach is a great place for finding peace and relaxation. Have you ever tried surfing?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Certainly! Here's the confirmation. [shares image: a photo of a man riding a surfboard on a wave in the ocean]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: How cool! But I never decided to try it.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: It's okay, maybe we can try it together sometime!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: I already know what fate awaits me if I do this! [shares image: a photo of a surfboard painted with a palm tree on it]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Have you ever been interested in this or do you know nothing about it?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Just started learning, but haven't gone yet. Want to come with me sometime?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: It'll be an adventure! Let's make it happen soon! [shares image: a photo of a sunset over the ocean with a boat in the distance]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: So glad, all that remains is to agree and choose the right time for both of us.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah:  Can't wait. What day works for you? I'm really excited!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Let's plan for next month - I'll check my schedule and let you know. Can't wait!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: I had a great time at the music festival with my pals! The vibes were unreal and the music was magical. It was so freeing to dance and bop around. Music brings us together and helps us show our feelings. It reminds me of my mom and her soothing voice when she'd sing lullabies to me. Lucky to have those memories!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Wow, festivals sound so fun! Here's me and my partner at one last year - had an awesome time! It's my way of expressing myself and getting away from all the stress of everyday life. Just got back from a trip with my partner - so cool! [shares image: a photo of a man and woman standing in a field at night]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Wow, what a gorgeous shot! It looks so tranquil and serene. You two look very happy together. Trips create awesome memories that we can share. Where did you go on your trip and what's something you'll never forget?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Thanks! We had an awesome yoga retreat. The place was so peaceful and the view during yoga was amazing - the sunrise lit up the whole sky with bright colors. It was so beautiful, it made us feel so alive and grateful. [shares image: a photo of a sunset over a valley with a horse]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Wow, what a view!  How did it make you feel?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: It was amazing! Doing yoga with that backdrop made me feel connected to nature and myself. I felt incredibly peaceful and thankful.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Like, it's no wonder looking at such beauty can really help us refocus and connect with who we are. Have you ever experienced that?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: I remember taking a hike with my partner and coming across a waterfall oasis. Everything just felt so peaceful and my worries just disappeared. It was such a refreshing experience.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: Are you planning to experience it again soon?

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Yeah! I'm planning to get out in nature again next month. It's going to be great reconnecting with it!

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah:  Enjoy it! This photo made me think of a gorgeous blossom tree from near my home. Every spring, it was magical to watch it bloom. [shares image: a photo of a pink flowered tree with a blue sky in the background]

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: That sounds magical! How was it watching the tree bloom each spring?

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: It was like admiring nature's artwork. It filled me with awe and made me appreciate the beauty of life. Even in tough times, there's hope for growth.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: This photo I took is a great visual representation of that idea. It reminds me that I can keep growing through any obstacles. [shares image: a photo of a plant growing out of a corner of a building]

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: It really captures resilience and strength. I love how you find inspiration in the small things.

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Thanks, Deborah! Appreciating those small things is important. It helps me remember that even when times are tough, there's always something positive to hang onto.

entries.speaker: Deborah
entries.text: Deborah: It's a great habit. Thanks for reminding me!

entries.speaker: Jolene
entries.text: Jolene: Sure Deb, it's great catching up. Keep on finding those beauties!

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Hey Dave! Nice to meet you! How's it going since we talked?

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Hey Calvin! Nice to meet you too! Things have been going well since we last talked. I attended this awesome event recently. It was like a car lover's paradise! They had so many classic cars on show, I was in awe. I even had the opportunity to speak with some of the owners and hear their fascinating stories. It was super inspiring. What about you? Anything exciting happening in your life lately?

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: That event sounds great! Something really exciting happened to me - I just had a big life change! Here's my new mansion - pretty cool huh? [shares image: a photo of a building with a sign on the front of it]

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Wow! Congrats on the big change! What inspired you to start this journey?

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: I'm so excited to learn about Japanese culture and get a chance to expand.

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Wow, Calvin, learning about new cultures is awesome! Have you ever been to Japan?

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Never been there before. Fascinated by the traditions and can't wait to get a taste of the culture.

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Wow, Japan sounds amazing. Can't wait to hear all about it! When are you leaving?

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text:
Calvin: I'm heading there next month. I'll be staying in such a nice place while I'm there.

 [shares image: a photo of a living room with a couch, table, and television]

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: That looks cozy! Where'd you find a place to stay there?

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Wow, my agent found me this awesome place, so thankful!

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Awesome! Having a place to stay is key. What are your plans for the trip?

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: I'm planning to explore the city, try out different local cuisines, and perhaps collaborate with musicians in the area.

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Sounds great! Collaborating with local musicians would be an amazing experience. How long are you planning to stay in Japan?

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: I'm gonna be in Japan for a few months then off to Boston! I can't wait!

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: That's great, can't wait for you to return from your trip. I've been spending lots of time at this beautiful park lately - so calming. Have you been there before? [shares image: a photography of a park with a lake and a few boats]

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: No, I've never been in that park. Looks like a chill spot. I'll definitely check it out when I'm back. Appreciate the tip!

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Cool! Enjoy your trip! Let me know if you need any more recommendations. Have fun!

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! If I need any help, I'll be sure to let you know. Stay safe!

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Hey Dave, been a few days, so I wanted to let you in on some cool news.  I just got a new car and it's amazing! Finally owning a luxury car was a dream come true and I'm so stoked.

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Woohoo, Calvin! Congrats on the new car! How's it driving?

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Nice car! It's an amazing ride - super smooth and real powerful. Like a rockstar behind the wheel! Thanks, man!

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Wow, Calvin! Owning something like this must feel amazing. Is this your first one? Show me a pic! What's it called?

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Woohoo! I finally got myself this beauty. Here's a pic from yesterday when I took it for a ride. Can't believe I'm actually driving it. Definitely what I deserve after all this hard work. Every time I step in, it's like an adrenaline rush! [shares image: a photo of a red sports car parked on the side of the road]

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Calvin, that car looks awesome! You must feel amazing every time you get inside! You deserved it - congrats buddy!

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Woah, I'm on cloud nine! Hard work pays off. What's up with you, Dave?

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Doing good. Last weekend, I went to a music festival in Boston - it was awesome! So many cool bands playing and the atmosphere was electric. I love music, it reminded me why I love it. Here's a pic, take a look. [shares image: a photo of a large crowd of people at a concert]

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Wow, sounds like a blast! Which one was your favorite?

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Wow, there were so many great bands! If I had to pick a favorite, it would definitely be Aerosmith. Their performance was incredible. I'll show you a pic I took when they were playing. [shares image: a photo of a concert with a large eagle on the stage]

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Cool! Lovin' Aerosmith.

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: I finally saw them live and it was such an amazing experience! He was jamming out to one of their hits. Check out this epic picture of them! [shares image: a photo of two people on stage with guitars and a microphone]

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Cool, Dave! Seeing your favorite singers live must have been wild! Did you get a chance to hang out with them after the show?

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Nah, didn't get to hang with them after the show, but seeing them live was cool enough. It's always a dream to see your favorites performing!

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Yeah, it's always a dream to see your favorites doing their thing! So glad you got to experience that.

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Yeah, it was an incredible experience. So, anything new happening in your life?

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Got a new ride and wrote some new tunes - had a few studio sessions last week and I'm excited to collaborate. Can't wait to share it with everyone!

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Cool, Calvin! Looking forward to hearing your new tunes. Keep me updated on how your collaborations go!

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Yeah, no worries! I'll definitely let you know how it goes. Cheers!

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Enjoy the collaborations, Calvin! Stay safe!

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Gonna have fun and stay safe with it. Bye!

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Hey Dave! Long time no see. I just went to an awesome music thingy in Tokyo - so cool!

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Hey Calvin! Great to hear from you. How was the music thingy in Tokyo? See any cool bands?

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Hey Dave! The festival in Tokyo was awesome! Didn't see any bands, but met lots of talented artists and industry people. Totally enriching!

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Wow, Calvin, sounds great! What did you learn from it?

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: I learned a lot and got some great advice from professionals in the music industry. It was inspiring!

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Wow, Calvin! Bet that was inspiring being surrounded by professionals. Did you get any advice from them?

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: The producer gave me some advice to stay true to myself and sound unique. It got me thinking about where I want my music to go. It's really motivating!

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Wow, Calvin! It's really motivating to see you staying true to yourself. It got me thinking, where do you see your music taking you?

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I'm dreaming of touring the world, performing for different people and connecting with them. I hope my music can reach a global audience and make an impact. I'm also looking forward to my upcoming trip to Boston after I finish the Frank Ocean tour. I've heard that the music scene there is awesome, so I can't wait to check it out!

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Sounds like an amazing plan, Cal! I can't wait for your trip to Boston. I'll show you around town and all the cool spots. The music scene there is awesome, with places like Paradise Rock, House of Blues, and Fenway Park. You'll definitely have some great performances there. Count me in for the front row when you're up onstage! Oh, and by the way, check out this pic. [shares image: a photography of a city skyline with a boat in the water]

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Wow, Boston looks great! Thanks for the tips. And, awesome pic!

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Last weekend I went to a car show. Classic cars are so charming and the dedication people put into restoring them is amazing. That's why I'm so into auto engineering. Can't wait to show you some when you come to Boston! Oh, almost forgot to send a photo, look at this beautiful car! [shares image: a photography of a green mustang parked in a field of grass]

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Wow, Dave, that car looks great! Take a look at my car, I put a lot of work into it. Can't wait to see more when I'm in Boston! [shares image: a photo of a red sports car on display at a show]

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Thanks! It definitely took a lot of work. Have you had a chance to check out Boston apart from the gigs?

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Not yet, been pretty busy with rehearsals and traveling. But I'm looking forward to exploring the city, trying out some delicious food, and visiting the popular attractions. Maybe we can grab a bite together when I'm there?

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Definitely, Cal! Let's grab some food and I'll show you my favorite spots in the city. Can't wait to show them to you!

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Sounds great, Dave! Can't wait to try out the food there with you. It'll be fun!

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: It'll be great, Cal! Can't wait to show you the amazing music and food here. See you soon!

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Hey Calvin, long time no see! A lot's been happening since we last talked. Guess what? I finally opened my own car maintenance shop! It's so satisfying to have a spot to work on cars - it's like a dream come true! Take a look at the photo. [shares image: a photo of a car dealership with cars parked in front of it]

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Wow Dave! Congrats on opening your own car maintenance shop! It looks like all your hard work and dedication paid off. [shares image: a photo of a man standing under a car in a garage]

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Thanks, Cal! It's great to see my hard work paying off. Opening this shop was my dream, and I'm really happy to see it getting started. It was a lot of hard work, but it was worth it.

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Woo, Dave! Congrats on achieving your dream - you've got guts and ambition - that's awesome! Keep it up! [shares image: a photo of a book with a space theme on it]

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Thanks! Appreciate the support. My dream was to open a shop and it's a step towards my other dream of working on classic cars. I love their design and engineering.

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Wow, Dave! Going for it with classic cars is cool! Fulfilling your dreams is so important. [shares image: a photo of a red car parked in a parking lot]

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: I'm obsessed with classic cars. They have a unique charm. I was so thrilled to restore one last year—nothing like bringing it back to life! Take a look at the engine of the restored car. [shares image: a photo of a car engine with a small air filter]

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Wow, Dave! That looks awesome!

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! It was a labor of love. Challenging, but so worth it.

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Yeah, it's awesome when you see something you worked on come to life.

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Yeah! It feels great to see the hard work pay off, it's like bringing something back to life.

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Yeah, it's an amazing feeling when you create something and it resonates with people. It's so satisfying when you finish something you made from scratch!

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Yeah, Calvin! It's such an amazing feeling to see something you create become a reality. Knowing that your skills and hard work made it happen is incredible.

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Yeah, Dave! Feels good when our hard work pays off. It's the perfect blend of dedication and passion!

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Yeah, that mix really keeps me motivated and makes it all worthwhile.

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Keep going for it!

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: I will! By the way, This is a photo of my shop. Come by sometime, if you can! [shares image: a photo of a group of people standing in front of a car]

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Wow, your shop looks great! I'd love to check it out sometime. What sort of cars do you work on at your shop?

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! I work on all kinds of cars at the shop - from regular maintenance to full restorations of classic cars. It keeps me busy and happy!

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Wow Dave, working on cars must be really rewarding.

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Definitely, working on cars is what I'm passionate about. Doing it every day is so rewarding! Seeing the transformation is awesome and knowing I'm helping people keep their cars in good condition is really satisfying.

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Wow Dave, that's awesome! Doing something you love and helping others is so rewarding. Keep up the great work!

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Thanks, Cal! I really appreciate the boost. It means a lot that my work is valued and that it brings joy to others.

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Glad to help, Dave! So awesome to see you doing your thing and making a difference. Your hard work and talent totally deserve all the recognition. Keep on keepin' on, bud! Take a look at this beautiful necklace with a diamond pendant, that's so stunning! [shares image: a photo of a gold necklace with a diamond pendant]

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Wow, that's a great necklace! Where did you get it?

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I got it from another artist as a gift - it's a great reminder of why I keep hustling as a musician!

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Awesome, Calvin! Keep pushing and making music, it'll remind us why we keep hustling.

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Yeah, Dave! The road can be hard, but when we remember why we're doing it, it keeps us going. Let's keep each other motivated!

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Hey Calvin! Long time no talk. How's it going? Crazy news - I'm teaming up with a local garage. Take a look at what we working on together! [shares image: a photo of a car being worked on in a garage]

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Hey Dave, great to hear from you! That's awesome news about teaming up with a local garage. Super inspiring seeing you follow your passion. Congratulations on this new venture. It's impressive how far you've come since we last chatted. How's everything going? [shares image: a photo of a green car in a garage with a sign in the background]

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! I'm loving this job. I get to work with awesome mechanics and share my knowledge about cars. Here's what I'm currently working on! It's a cool project, even if it's a bit challenging. 🤩 [shares image: a photography of a man working on a car engine in a garage]

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: That car looks awesome! You're putting in a lot of effort and it's great to see the end result. Keep up the good work. Got any plans for what's next?

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Thanks Calvin! Appreciate the support. I'm gonna keep learning more about auto engineering, maybe even build a custom car from scratch someday - that's the dream! For now, just gonna keep working on this project and assisting customers.

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Wow, Dave! You're so inspiring - good for you for pushing yourself to achieve your dream. Making a custom car sounds awesome. Don't forget to relax and enjoy the process too!

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Gotta take time to chill. Do you have any hobbies that help you relax?

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Hey Dave, long drives in [this car] really help me relax. The feeling of the wind and the open road is so freeing. It helps me clear my head. What do you like to do to chill out?  [shares image: a photo of a red sports car driving down a road]

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Yeah, I hear you! Driving with the wind in your hair is so calming. Taking a walk around is a great way to destress, too. Exploring, taking in the sights and sounds - it's such a peaceful experience.

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Yea, I totally hear ya. Embracing nature has been really calming for me too. I've been loving getting to know Japanese culture. On the other hand, I'm stuck with my music at the moment, like my creativity's frozen or something. Any tips?

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: If I'm having trouble coming up with ideas, I usually immerse myself in something I love, like concerts or my favorite albums. Doing that usually helps to jumpstart my inspiration. Maybe try taking a break from music and explore other things. Plus, have some fun while you're at it!

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Taking a break is great for getting my mojo back. I'll definitely take your advice and explore. Appreciate the help! You're awesome!

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: No worries, Calvin! Glad I could help. Keep pursuing your music and never give up. You're awesome! 🤘

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Thanks, appreciate it. Won't give up. Let's stay in touch! Bye!

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Sure, Calvin! Keep in touch. If you ever need help, just let me know. Bye!

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Hey Dave! Long time no chat! Lots has gone down since we last caught up.

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Hey Calvin! Long time no chat! How's everything been going since we last caught up?

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Hey Dave, not everything has been going smoothly. I had an incident last week where my place got flooded, but thankfully, I managed to save my music gear and favorite microphone. It's been tough, but I'm staying positive and looking forward to getting everything fixed up.

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Man, that's rough, Calvin. Sorry to hear about that. But I'm glad you could save your music gear and mic - those are the important things. Stay positive, pal. Anything I can do to help?

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Thanks, Dave. Appreciate the support. Waiting on insurance to kick in so I can start repairs - fingers crossed it won't take too long. Take a look at my creative haven, where I pour my heart into the music. [shares image: a photo of a music studio with a keyboard, synthesizer, and other musical equipment]

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: That studio looks awesome, Cal! I hope you get it fixed soon so you can continue creating music. Hang in there!

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Can't wait to get back to making music. Anything exciting you're working on these days?

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: I'm so excited, I opened my car shop last week! Invited some friends over to celebrate and it's been amazing. Super stoked to share my passion and help out with folks' rides. It's been incredible so far.

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Way to go, Dave! Congrats on opening your own car shop! Your excitement is contagious. Keep up the great work!

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Your support is greatly appreciated. It's been quite a journey so far, and I'm excited to see what the future holds. How about you? Anything exciting happening in the world of music for you?

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text: Calvin: Thanks Dave! Super excited for my upcoming performance in Tokyo this month. It's gonna be great to show my music to a whole new crowd and hopefully expand my following!

entries.speaker: Dave
entries.text: Dave: Cool, Cal! Doing a show in Tokyo, wow! I'm sure the audience is gonna love it. Wishing you all the luck! Let me know how it goes.

entries.speaker: Calvin
entries.text:
Calvin: Sure thing, Dave! I'll keep you posted on how it goes. Thanks for the good luck! Look what a wonderful night! 
 [shares image: a photo of a city at night with a lot of lights]
